lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, arranged in approximately six visible longitudinal rows parallel to the body axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal rows of spots, creating a grid where the spots serve as high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and lower-intensity shadow pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Observed transition in spot patterning from high-density, small diameter clusters on the cranial surface to low-density, larger diameter spots on the lateral flank.
